summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results and announcing the appointment of Colin Parkin as CEO, effective May 14, 2026, replacing founder Shawn Qu who transitions to Executive Chairman and CTO. The change is a planned leadership succession, not a forced departure. No deal terms are involved. The filing also disclosed quarterly results with solar module shipments of 2.5 GW, energy storage shipments of 2.1 GWh, and net revenues of $1.1 billion. The management change is the special-situation event.
